title: Only 50% Of Gen Z-Age Adults Still Drink
hook: Drinking once felt automatic. Now only 50% of young adults drink.
closing: Gen Z made skipping alcohol as normal as ordering it.
question: Do you drink less than your parents?

segments.say: Only 50 percent of young adults now drink. Skipping alcohol is as common as ordering it.
Drinking among the youngest adults fell to 35 percent. The old default broke fastest there.
Only 61 percent of young drinkers drank in the past week. Even drinkers are cutting back.
